data.label: include
data.reason_zh: 改进提示优化器：过滤噪声任务并复用历史成功轨迹，rollout反馈驱动，优化后的提示用于后续任务与优化轮次。

scope_support.feedback_quote: Existing reflective prompt optimizers such as GEPA learn from failed rollouts
scope_support.object_quote: a framework that augments the prompt optimizer to select which agent experiences should shape prompt optimization
scope_support.persistence_quote: prior success retrieval, which selectively retrieves past successful trajectories for a task and provides them as additional context to the prompt optimizer
